# Ledger verify contract (Crumbline ledger)

Purpose: how Synapse re-verifies a Crumbline ledger produced by
`crumbs::ledger::Ledger::verify(genesis, records)` in aien-sovereign-core.

Owner of the function: agent beta (other repository). Not verified against
the source here; this note records only what beta stated.

## Answer from beta (question Q1)

Relayed by the orchestrator (message sent 2026-10-16T13:02:07Z):

> For an empty record slice, Ledger::verify returns Ok(genesis), the starting
> digest passed in, since the loop body never runs. For a broken chain it
> returns Err(LedgerError::Chain) at the first bad record, where a record fails
> if its prev_root does not equal the running head or its recomputed root does
> not equal its stored root (no partial head is returned). Any non-empty, fully
> valid slice returns Ok of the last record's root.

## What Synapse should expect

- Empty input: success, result is the genesis digest.
- Broken chain: failure with a chain error, reported at the first bad record.
  No partial head is returned, so a caller cannot use a half-verified root.
- Valid non-empty input: success, result is the last record's root.

## Open items

- Beta's answer has not been checked against the aien-sovereign-core source.
